eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Two
subtitle: Lesson 14 · Filtering and Sorting

code:
WHERE LastName LIKE 'Sm%';

WHERE LastName LIKE '%son%';
caption: 'Sm%' matches Smith, Smart, Sm... '%son%' matches anything containing 'son'.
Each underscore is exactly one character — no more, no fewer.

code:
WHERE LastName LIKE '[CK]ing';

WHERE LastName LIKE '[A-M]%';
caption: Matches Cing or King. Or any name starting with a letter A through M.
The caret inside brackets negates the set — anything NOT starting A through M.

subtitle: Shorter ways to write a list of OR conditions or a range.
